The '''Orixon Raiders''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when they managed to destroy dozens of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] within a matter of days.<ref name="Mission" />
